column1: # The essentials layer: one row per mod folder under persist's mods/ (docs/MODS.md, lab/tools/persist-mods.sh reads this).

# source fenestrate: ref is the Vortex staging folder pulled read-only from Fenestrate into lab/.cache/mods/fenestrate; check is tree:<sha256 over the sorted "sha256  path" lines of its files after exclusions>.
# source nexus: ref is <mod id>/<file id>|<archive in lab/.cache/mods>; check is md5:<archive md5>; take lists <archive folder>-><Data folder> in install order (a later one overwrites).

# Rows install in order, as a mod manager does: a later row's file replaces an earlier row's at the same Data path, and persist-mods drops the replaced copy from the tree (Goam's skin textures replace CBBE's this way).
# source out: not placed; the note says why. exclude: file names or globs left out. plugins: the mod's plugins in load order.
